Key Findings

  • Initial access via a reservation-system integration API key leaked in a public code repository.
  • Loyalty database exported over a weekend without alerting.
  • Passport scans stored in plaintext on a shared drive.
  • GDPR notification to the Portuguese supervisory authority (CNPD) applies.

Data Obtained

  • Guest reservations and loyalty member profiles
  • Passport scans collected at check-in
  • Corporate client rate agreements
  • Staff HR and payroll
  • Property finance and owner reports
